evidence_gaps.what: Ground clearance figure and suspension specification
evidence_gaps.why_it_matters: Wheel sizes alone cannot answer questions about speed breakers or rough roads.
evidence_gaps.suggested_source: Official specification sheet dimensions and suspension tables for the exact model year.

evidence_gaps.what: Measured ride comfort on rough roads
evidence_gaps.why_it_matters: No comfort or road-absorption comparison follows from the wheel choices.
evidence_gaps.suggested_source: A documented road test on relevant surfaces with the engine, trim and tyres identified.

evidence_gaps.what: Boot volume, rear legroom and overall length and width
evidence_gaps.why_it_matters: The seat and boot features do not establish personal luggage fit, passenger comfort or parking fit.
evidence_gaps.suggested_source: Official brochure dimensions and luggage capacity tables, followed by a showroom fit check with the buyer.

evidence_gaps.what: Crash-test rating and body structure safety evidence for this exact model and year
evidence_gaps.why_it_matters: Standard airbags and assistance features do not establish a crash rating.
evidence_gaps.suggested_source: The applicable official crash-test report and manufacturer body safety section.

evidence_gaps.what: Certified or measured fuel economy for each engine and transmission
evidence_gaps.why_it_matters: Running cost cannot be estimated from the supplied marketing descriptions.
evidence_gaps.suggested_source: Official fuel economy certification table and a clearly described real-world fuel-use test.

evidence_gaps.what: Measured acceleration and fully loaded diesel performance on a long climb
evidence_gaps.why_it_matters: Power and torque figures do not establish acceleration times or loaded climbing performance.
evidence_gaps.suggested_source: Instrumented road-test results identifying the exact engine, load, route and test conditions.

evidence_gaps.what: Current on-road prices by trim for the buyer’s city
evidence_gaps.why_it_matters: The supplied entry price is dated, has a conflicting value in the same source and excludes local additions.
evidence_gaps.suggested_source: A current itemised Hyundai dealer quotation naming the city, trim and engine.

evidence_gaps.what: Standard warranty, service intervals, maintenance costs, and paid extended warranty coverage and prices
evidence_gaps.why_it_matters: The paid petrol warranty eligibility alone cannot answer the cost and coverage questions of ownership.
evidence_gaps.suggested_source: Official warranty booklet, service schedule, local authorised service estimate and current extended warranty package terms.

evidence_gaps.why_it_matters: The registry does not support a future resale promise.
evidence_gaps.suggested_source: Recent documented used-car sale valuations matched for age, trim, mileage and city.

evidence_gaps.why_it_matters: The category library includes this feature, but the supplied registry cannot support mentioning it as fitted.
evidence_gaps.suggested_source: Official brochure feature availability table and a corresponding cabin photo.

evidence_gaps.what: Local stock, delivery dates and an actual test-drive booking destination
evidence_gaps.why_it_matters: The demo cannot promise availability or offer a working booking route without these details.
evidence_gaps.suggested_source: The chosen dealer’s current stock confirmation and verified test-drive booking page.

notes: The tour walks toward the drive home after a hot, busy day: rest a braking foot while stationary where auto hold is fitted, adapt the rear seat to the day’s passengers and bags, and feel airflow through the front seat cushions on an eligible trim. Keep the library’s fundamental order; move delighters immediately after safety to serve that moment, then cover cabin controls and ownership. All library stops have some support, so all remain required; their gaps limit what may be said. Auto hold is unavailable on E, EX, EX(O) and SX; it is automatic-only on S(O), S(O) Knight and SX Premium, and standard on King, King Knight and Lounge. The current engine matrix has no automatic S(O) Knight combination, so do not offer one. Do not imply auto hold works on all surfaces. Ventilated front seats start at SX Premium; describe airflow through the cushions, not cabin cooling, refrigerated air or a cooldown time. The rear split seat is standard; reclining rear seats start at S(O). Wheel choices do not prove ride comfort or ground clearance. Engine choices are trim-dependent: the turbo and its automatic gearbox appear only in King, and not every King is turbo. Driver assistance is for King, King Knight and Lounge; adaptive stop-go is automatic-only there, and attentive driving remains essential. Cameras starting at SX Premium do not extend the other assistance features to it. Plain panoramic roof availability starts at EX(O), voice control at SX. The sound system starts at SX Premium. Preserve the exact screen measurement if used. Wireless phone mirroring on SX and above uses a wired-to-wireless adapter and requires compatibility. Connected services require power and network coverage; the stated remote engine-start function is through Alexa, with separate hardware, not an evidenced phone-app feature. Do not treat the charging pad or rear seatback table visible in the supplied images as approved features. Pictures support only what their descriptions literally show and never establish trim availability. Unknown objections may be acknowledged using partial facts, but must remain unanswered where evidence is missing. If quoting the supplied entry ex-showroom price, name its date, disclose the conflict and require the latest dealer quote; do not present it as current or on-road. Extended warranty is paid separately, with up to seven years stated only for petrol. No market-statistic hook is supported or needed.
